answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pulse re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. The design leans on game-theoretic equilibrium in agent coordination.
